maria (PM): Quick sync — need to finalize the API surface for quota/pricing fields before roadmap freeze. Main concerns: per-route token accounting, per-API-key vs per-user quotas, billing granularity (tokens vs request units), and a low-friction migration for existing customers. Inputs?

cheng (Eng): Per-route enforcement should live in the request router/proxy so we can apply different policies per route/model. Token accounting = input + output tokens by default. Streaming: count tokens as they're emitted. Function/tool calls: bill model-generated tokens; external tool responses should not be double-billed. Edge cases: partial responses and aborts — still bill tokens generated.

alex (DevEx): For developer UX, expose fields in the route config and the API response so customers can debug. Proposal (example route metadata):
```json
{
  "route": "/chat/invoice",
  "quota": {
    "window": "30d",
    "limit": 5000000,
    "unit": "tokens",
    "scope": "api_key"
  },
  "pricing_modifier": 1.2,
  "billing_fields": ["input_tokens","output_tokens","model_id"]
}
```
Keep naming consistent: `tokens`, `embeddings_units`, `requests`. Default = `tokens`.

sam (Finance): Important: pricing needs to tie to both model footprint and route-level SLAs. We should allow a `pricing_modifier` on routes (0.5–3x) so sales can configure premium routes. Migration: customers on legacy per-request pricing should get a metrics-calibrated mapping for 90 days with a soft cap. Also need clear metering semantics for invoice line items:
- measure: input_tokens, output_tokens, embedding_vectors (count)
- aggregation: per-billing-account monthly
- overage: charge at list price unless negotiated

nina (CS): We have multiple customers asking for per-user quotas (to prevent external abuse). Two asks: per-user rate limiting inside a customer's org and per-api-key quotas for admin control. Both needed. Suggest support for nested scopes: `scope: ["api_key","org_user"]` and a default fallback to api_key.

cheng (Eng): Implementation notes:
- Proxy keeps token counters per (billing_account, route, scope_id) in Redis with TTL matching the window.
- Expose headers on responses: `x-rwd-quota-remaining`, `x-rwd-quota-reset` for observability.
- Charge only for tokens attributed to the request. For function/tool calling: attribute tokens to the parent request.

maria (PM): Can we finalize the API fields we expose? Draft: `quota.window`, `quota.limit`, `quota.unit`, `quota.scope`, `quota.soft_limit` (bool), `pricing_modifier`, `billing_fields` (list). Also need `enforcement_mode` = ["hard","soft"] for migration.

alex (DevEx): Agree. For soft enforcement we should return warnings in the response body and emit telemetry to the Console. Example warning header: `x-rwd-quota-warning: "soft-limit exceeded"`.

sam (Finance): One more ask: add `billing.breakdown` signals for invoices: `model_id`, `route`, `unit_price`, `units_consumed`. Without this, downstream billing will be painful.

nina (CS): Customer concern: can route-specific modifiers be applied retroactively? We should disallow retroactive pricing modifications — only future billing windows. Call this out in the policy.

ops-bot: Reminder: roadmap freeze in 7 days. PRD due EOD Friday. Meeting scheduled: <https://calendar.example/meet/1764209>

maria (PM): Action items:
- cheng: prototype enforcement + headers (spike 3d)
- alex: PRD section for DevEx UX and header semantics
- sam: invoice line-item schema and migration pricing plan
- nina: compile top 5 customer asks for per-user quotas
Deadline: PRD draft by Friday EOD. Please add short comments to the PRD doc. :+1:

cheng (Eng): Ack — will push proto branch and a simple demo script: `scripts/quota_demo.sh` that shows header outputs.

alex (DevEx): I’ll draft examples for SDKs: snippet for reading `x-rwd-quota-remaining`.

maria (PM): Thanks team — we'll aim to include this in the next minor release if PRD + spike look good.
